sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Light Value-Added Postponement Packaging and Custom Kitting

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (United States-derived common law with customary law elements)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the Republic of the Marshall Islands and the United States of America (2003 Amended)
Pacific Islands Trade and Investment Agreements under the Pacific Islands Forum framework (non-BIT, trade facilitation scope)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act of the Marshall Islands, Title 28, RMI Revised Code (1990, as amended); Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2008 (P.L. 2008-22, as amended); Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2021; Bank Commission Act (for licensed financial entities); all applicable FATF Recommendation 24 beneficial ownership provisions.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport (or national identity document) for each director, officer, founding shareholder and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority of the PERSON'S COUNTRY OF CITIZENSHIP (e.g., U.S. Department of State)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille on the notarized copy (or original if certified)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming source of funds and good standing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing commercial bank or licensed financial institution

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Incumbency for the ultimate corporate parent (if UBO is a legal entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign company registry or registered agent of the parent jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization if parent is in non-Hague state)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: IPO / Certificate of Registered Agent Appointment (for the proposed Marshall Islands Business Corporation)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Marshall Islands Registrar (PVR) via licensed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: No external authentication required for internally registered instrument

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, UBOs, and signatories against the consolidated United Nations Security Council sanctions lists, the U.S. Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons (SDN) list, and the Marshall Islands domestic list of terror entities. Enhanced due diligence is required for any person considered a politically exposed person (PEP) under FATF Recommendation 12. Screening evidence must be retained for five years after termination of the business relationship.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act (BCCA), Title 27 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code, as amended; Sections 47-48 (Articles of Incorporation and corporate name), 61 (registered agent and registered office), 92-93 (bylaws), 105 (official filing fees), and 111 (annual report and franchise tax)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Justice and Department of the Attorney General, Majuro Atoll, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Corporate Charter) on Registrar Form 2
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; a non-resident business corporation may be formed with nominal capital (e.g., 1,000 no-par shares subscribed at US$0.01 per share); neither escrow deposit, capital importation approval, nor paid-up parity is required
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation accept the subscription for 1,000 no-par common shares at US$0.01 per share from the founding subscriber, and the officers are authorized to issue and deliver the corresponding share certificate upon receipt of the subscription proceeds. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Corporation be established at c/o [Registered Agent], Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, and that said agent is appointed registered agent to accept service of process and maintain statutory records. RESOLVED, that [Name] be appointed President, [Name] Secretary, and [Name] Treasurer, to serve until successors are elected, with authority to open bank accounts and execute contracts for the Corporation's kitting, packaging, and fulfillment business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Availability Search and Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro (filings made directly or through a licensed RMI registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a name search against the Registrar's index of active entities. Select a name distinguishable from existing registrations and bearing a corporate identifier such as Corp., Inc., or Ltd. File a name reservation request with the Registrar or instruct the registered agent to hold the name, and pay the applicable reservation fee.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is refused as deceptively similar, file a written administrative review request within 30 days or immediately select an alternate distinguishable name and re-file the reservation; no filing fee is refunded but the alternate name is processed on a priority basis.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator or licensed RMI registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles on the statutory Form 2 setting forth the corporate name, registered agent and registered office address in Majuro, broad purpose clause covering warehousing, distribution, kitting and light assembly, authorized share structure, and any permitted limitations on director liability. The incorporator executes the Articles; notarization is required only when the Registrar's current filing rules demand it for non-agent submissions.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a query on the draft, file a revised or restated Charter within 10 business days addressing the stated deficiency; ministerial corrections do not require re-notarization or additional state fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Charter and Payment of Official Filing Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro (electronic or in-person filing window)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed Articles together with the Registrar's transmittal cover sheet and the registered agent's consent. Pay the official filing fee of US$500 (first US$50,000 of authorized capital or the Registrar's current fee schedule) by bank wire or certified check drawn in favor of the RMI government. Retain the dated filing receipt.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is rejected for a curable defect, the Registrar issues a written notice; cure the defect and re-submit within 30 days, and the original filing date is preserved; if the defect is substantive, file amended Articles with a new filing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Opening of Registry Record
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon acceptance, the Registrar endorses the Articles, opens the public registry record, and issues a dated Certificate of Incorporation together with a certified copy of the stamped Charter. Verify the corporate number, exact legal name, registered agent, and non-resident designation on the certificate before circulating the document to the board.
required_dossiers: Registry extract showing registered agent and office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains an error in name, number, or date, apply for a Certificate of Correction under BCCA Section 75; corrections are processed within 2 business days at a nominal administrative fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting or Unanimous Written Consent and Appointment of Officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Corporation (meeting may be held by telephone or written consent without a meeting)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or obtain unanimous written consent of the initial director. Adopt the Bylaws; confirm the registered agent and registered office; approve the issue of subscribed shares and the opening of the share ledger; appoint the President, Secretary, and Treasurer; adopt the fiscal year; and pass resolutions for the opening of corporate bank accounts and execution of banking mandates with payment rails including ACH Direct and Airwallex.
required_dossiers: Waiver of notice or consent to first meeting
Unanimous written consent or minutes of first meeting
Subscription agreement and share certificate stub
Bank account resolution and officer appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a notice, quorum, or authorization defect is later alleged, ratify the act by unanimous written consent of all directors and shareholders pursuant to BCCA Sections 77 and 78; the ratification retroactively validates the defective corporate action.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Registers, Annual Compliance, and Conditional Local Licensing Review
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations; Ministry of Finance, Business License Office (only if physical operations are established)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the registers of members, directors, officers, and charges; issue the share certificate. File the first annual corporate report and pay the annual franchise tax within the statutory window. If the entity operates purely as a non-resident offshore corporation, no local business license is due; if a physical kitting/fulfillment facility is established, apply for the Business License and the clearances described in Section 3, noting that any onshore taxable activity will alter the non-resident tax-exempt position.
required_dossiers: Register of members, directors, and officers
Annual report form and franchise tax receipt
Issued share certificate and stock ledger
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: For a late annual report or franchise tax payment, file the overdue report with the statutory late fee and request administrative reinstatement under BCCA Section 111; reinstatement restores good standing and the certificate is re-issued within 5 business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Business License Office, Tax and Revenue Division, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (coordinating with the Foreign Investment Board for foreign-owned physical establishments)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business License under the Business License Act 1989, supplemented by a Foreign Investment Business License under the Foreign Investment Business Act 1996 where the kitting and fulfillment facility is owned or controlled by non-nationals; no industry-specific occupational license is mandated for ISIC 5210 warehousing activities

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMIEPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B - Environmental Registration; a full Environmental Impact Assessment is not mandated for light kitting, packaging, and fulfillment warehousing unless the facility involves new construction above RMIEPA screening thresholds, hazardous substance storage, or significant emissions-generating equipment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero liquid process effluent; stormwater management per RMIEPA stormwater guidelines; VOC concentrations from packaging adhesives and cleaning agents limited to RMIEPA ambient air standards; solid waste segregation and disposal per RMI Solid Waste Management Regulations; prohibition on ozone-depleting substances in packaging operations

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the RMI Fire Department before commencement of operations; structural load inspection and approval of racking and mezzanine systems by the Majuro building safety inspectorate; workplace occupational health and safety registration and clearance under RMI OSH regulations; approved emergency evacuation and fire suppression plans

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Tax and Customs Administration (TCA), Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands; taxpayer portal: https://www.finance.gov.mh
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident Business Corporation files its articles of incorporation with the Registrar of Corporations, then registers as a non-resident domestic corporation and applies to the Tax and Customs Administration for a Tax Exemption Certificate. No VAT/TIN is issued because the Marshall Islands imposes no VAT/GST; the unique taxpayer reference is the Tax Exemption Certificate number, aligned with the corporate registration number.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Election under the Business Corporations Act to operate as a non-resident tax-exempt corporation; no check-the-box pass-through election or hybrid mismatch election is available because the Marshall Islands imposes no corporate income tax. Tax-exempt status is evidenced by an administrative Certificate of Tax Exemption issued by the Minister of Finance.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST/Sales and Use Tax; indirect revenue is collected through customs import duties and excise-style levies only.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable; no indirect tax registration threshold exists. A customs import license or bond is nevertheless required for physical importation, and duty is assessed per the RMI Customs Tariff as applicable.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API integration, or digital stamping mandate exists. Import declarations are processed through the customs electronic declaration system; e-invoicing is not required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable for VAT, as the Marshall Islands levies no VAT/GST. Exported goods and offshore services fall outside the scope of RMI indirect taxation; exporters of physical goods may, where applicable, claim a customs duty drawback for duty-paid imported inputs incorporated into exported products and re-exported within the statutory period.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent misdeclaration in export or duty drawback filings is investigated by the Customs and Tax Administration; penalties may include forfeiture of goods, retrospective duty clawback and refund recovery, monetary fines up to USD 25,000 per offense, and imprisonment of responsible individuals for up to three years under the Customs Act and Revenue Administration provisions.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands has no true central bank; the US dollar is the sole legal tender under the Compact of Free Association. Banking supervision is carried out by the Office of the Banking Commissioner (Banking Commission) under the Banking Act 1987, while treasury policy and financial administration reside with the Ministry of Finance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility in both current and capital accounts because the jurisdiction circulates the US dollar. There are no exchange controls, no surrender requirements, and no approval barriers to profit or dividend remittances by non-resident business corporations. Any practical friction is limited to bank-level AML/KYC verification of the underlying trade documentary trail.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. The Marshall Islands imposes no statutory timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no surrender obligation for export proceeds or service receipts. USD-denominated receivables may be retained, swept, or remitted offshore without approval from any monetary authority.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account; Capital Escrow Account on request

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. The Marshall Islands has no fintech EMI or payments-institution licensing category; the Banking Act 1987 limits deposit-taking to licensed banks. Offshore digital EMIs such as Airwallex or Wise cannot open domestic settlement accounts in the RMI and may only serve as non-resident, multi-currency clearing adjuncts for outbound trade disbursements. The primary operational account must be held with a licensed domestic bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical onboarding interview for at least one authorised signatory-director is strongly recommended and is the default requirement at BMI and Bank of Guam. Remote opening is permissible only where the bank already maintains an introducer relationship with the RMI registered agent and the full corporate kit is apostilled, with a notarised video interview and certified board resolution. First-time non-resident treasury accounts should assume an in-person Majuro appearance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Marshall Islands business corporation with nominee directors or shareholders and thin commercial substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified certificate of good standing and full chain-of-title corporate register extract from the Registrar of Corporations; notarised and apostilled corporate charters, bylaws and director/shareholder resolutions; bank-prescribed beneficial ownership declaration proving the ultimate human owner; plus an explanation of the commercial purpose for the RMI structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity third-party payment flows characteristic of a 3PL kitting and fulfilment entity in a low-capital vehicle
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed warehousing, kitting and assembly agreements with end customers; purchase orders; vendor invoices; SKU-level transaction subledgers; evidence that funds represent genuine trades payable/receivable and do not involve crypto-assets, gambling or regulated goods; annual compliance refresh and independent audit of the transaction trail.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Frequent cross-border disbursements to Asian fulfilment suppliers from a jurisdiction with zero local staff and no physical warehouse
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed vendor contracts, commercial invoices, packing lists and bills of lading; detailed SWIFT field-70 narrative describing goods and service; pre-notification and transaction-level compliance lines for wires above USD 50,000; retained reconciliation of each disbursement to an underlying customer contract; evidence that the registered agent holds books and records in Majuro.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Parent or shareholder routes USD via SWIFT MT103 through US correspondent clearing (Fedwire/CHIPS) to the RMI operational account. The beneficiary field must show the entity registration number in the Marshall Islands; the MT103 field 70 must carry a clear purpose code such as GIFT/INVCAP for paid-in capital, LOAN for intercompany debt, or PURCHASE for trade funding. No RMI central-bank approval is required; the receiving bank performs standard enhanced due diligence on source of funds and the wire must include complete originator and beneficiary identity metadata under FATF recommendation 16.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Open-account 3PL and kitting disbursements settle via SWIFT MT103 over BMI's US correspondent network (Bank of Hawaii) or Bank of Guam's US correspondents, clearing on Fedwire/CHIPS. Higher-value purchases are supported by Commercial Documentary Letters of Credit issued on MT700 by the domestic RMI bank, typically 30 to 90 days against shipping documents. Airwallex is used exclusively as an offshore multi-currency payout rail outside RMI for EUR, GBP, AUD, SGD and HKD disbursements, never as an on-island settlement account.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Offshore USD/EUR and USD/AUD outright forwards executed with international bank counterparties under ISDA/NDF documentation, used for invoice-level hedging because the RMI has no domestic FX market.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing USD against soft-currency trade partners where physical delivery of the foreign currency is impracticable.
Cross-currency swaps between USD and AUD, EUR or GBP executed outside the Marshall Islands under an ISDA master agreement; domestically licensed RMI banks do not offer on-shore derivative products.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report of the non-resident Business Corporation, setting out registered office and registered agent details, directors and officers, authorized and issued share capital, share transfer summary, and a non-resident tax-exempt status declaration (which also resolves any Marshall Islands income tax / gross revenue tax filing obligation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro); filed by the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation in each calendar year; the filing must be completed on or before the incorporation anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of $100 per month or part of a month of delinquency; the Registrar withholds certificates of good standing and registration copies until arrears are settled; two consecutive unfiled annual reports and unpaid government fees trigger administrative strike-off (dissolution), reinstatable only upon payment of all arrears, penalties, and reinstatement fees

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Economic substance declaration / relevant-activity notification under the Marshall Islands Economic Substance Regulations 2019; nil filing for this non-resident, tax-exempt entity with no RMI-source income and no related-party distribution or service-center activity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations (economic substance compliance record); submitted through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation, filed concurrently with the Annual Report; nil declaration applicable to the non-resident tax-exempt status of this entity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No separate government fee; a false declaration or inadequate economic-substance evidence where a relevant activity is in fact carried on may result in an economic-substance review, monetary penalties, and ultimately administrative strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit applies to a non-resident, tax-exempt Business Corporation with no Marshall Islands-source income. An audit is triggered only where the articles or bylaws, a shareholder/director resolution, or a lender or counterparty contract requires it; none of these triggers is present for this entity.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The Business Corporations Act does not mandate a specific accounting framework for this entity; the corporation must maintain accurate books of account reflecting its financial position. IFRS or US GAAP may be adopted at the directors' discretion, and no financial statements are filed with the Registrar or the tax administration.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Marshall Islands maintains no public beneficial-ownership register. The licensed registered agent must hold current beneficial-ownership information under the RMI Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism framework and will require an annual written UBO confirmation from the company; every share transfer is recorded in the Register of Members immediately upon transfer and is reflected in the next annual confirmation to the registered agent.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $900 - $2,500 per year (licensed Marshall Islands registered agent and registered office, inclusive of annual report facilitation and AML/UBO compliance documentation for a low-risk non-resident Business Corporation)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable as no statutory audit is required; a voluntary certified audit of a small kitting, fulfillment, and assembly entity would typically range from $4,500 - $12,000 per engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% effective rate for a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation (NRDC); the Marshall Islands imposes no corporate income tax on foreign-source income. The general statutory rate of 3% applies only to income derived from sources within the Marshall Islands; a fully offshore fulfillment, kitting, and assembly operation derives zero RMI-source income.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 1. NRDC statutory exemption from income tax on all income arising outside the Marshall Islands. 2. Territorial tax system: no tax on offshore warehouse, kitting, or assembly profits. 3. No capital gains tax, no VAT/GST, no payroll tax, no branch profits tax, and no stamp duty on offshore transactions. 4. No minimum capital requirement and no deemed-profit or deemed-dividend regime for offshore logistics entities. 5. Complete exemption from the RMI social security and health fund levies for non-resident employees working wholly outside the RMI.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Report Form (Business Corporations Act, Section 52), submitted electronically through the RMI Registrar of Corporations e-filing system via the licensed registered agent's secure portal. No corporate income tax return is filed by a tax-exempt NRDC. If any RMI-source income is inadvertently derived, the entity must file a Corporate Income Tax Return (RMI Income Tax Act Form 3) with the Revenue and Taxation Division.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Annual Report is due on the anniversary date of incorporation each year. There is no statutory grace period; a late surcharge is imposed immediately upon failure to file by the anniversary date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name of the corporation as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the full registered English name; non-resident entities may use any name permissible under the Business Corporations Act.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent's name and physical address in the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be a licensed RMI registered agent; a PO Box is not sufficient. The agent is the primary point of service of process.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office street address in the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This address is generally the registered agent's office; the offshore entity need not lease its own premises in Majuro.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal business office address outside the RMI.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the actual operational address of the fulfillment warehouse, kitting facility, or assembly plant; foreign addresses are accepted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital (number of shares and par value).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Indicate the full authorized capital; the annual franchise fee and late penalties are tiered by authorized capital amounts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors and officers (names, nationalities, and addresses).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors and officers are permitted; no RMI residency requirement applies.
Tick the exemption box and confirm that no income is derived from sources within the Marshall Islands; maintaining this declaration preserves zero-tax status.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: The base annual government fee ranges from USD 50 (authorized capital up to USD 250,000) to USD 1,500 (authorized capital above USD 500,000,000). A late-filing surcharge accrues monthly after the anniversary date; failure to file for two consecutive years triggers administrative dissolution by the Registrar and loss of the NRDC tax-exempt status.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Return (Form 3), filed with the RMI Revenue and Taxation Division (Ministry of Finance). Applicable only if the corporation derives Marshall Islands-source income.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (calendar year or approved fiscal year).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before the last day of the third month following the close of the tax year (31 March for calendar-year taxpayers).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income derived from sources within the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all invoices billed to RMI customers or attributable to RMI-source activities; offshore 3PL revenue is excluded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible business expenses and statutory exemptions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deduct ordinary and necessary expenses apportioned to RMI-source income; no deduction is allowed for a foreign parent's offshore overhead unless incurred in earning RMI-source income.
Multiply taxable income by the statutory 3% rate; no withholding set-off is available in the absence of a comprehensive double tax treaty.
Not applicable where no DTA exists; credit is granted only under domestic unilateral provisions, which are generally unavailable to non-resident corporations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 5% of the tax due per month or part thereof, capped at 25%; interest on underpayment accrues at 1% per month. Wilful failure to file or filing a false return may attract criminal fines up to USD 10,000 and imprisonment up to three years.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0%. The Marshall Islands does not impose any withholding tax on dividends paid by a domestic corporation to a non-resident shareholder, irrespective of shareholding percentage.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The Marshall Islands has no comprehensive double taxation agreements (DTAs) in force; only limited bilateral shipping and aviation agreements exist (e.g., with the United States). Consequently, no DTA withholding reduction can be invoked for outbound RMI dividends. Where a foreign treaty partner imposes withholding tax on dividends, interest, or royalties flowing to an RMI entity, the Tax Exemption Certificate (Certificate of Tax Residence / TRC) is obtained by the registered agent from the RMI Revenue and Taxation Division and submitted to the foreign payer or tax authority. Because the RMI domestic withholding rate is nil, no domestic treaty-relief application procedure is required.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% for both IP royalties and debt interest paid by an RMI corporation to non-residents. Treaty rate: N/A (no comprehensive DTA network). No branch remittance tax or additional profits tax applies to a non-resident-owned entity.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None. The Marshall Islands has no statutory transfer pricing rules, no Local File, no Master File, and no country-by-country (CbC) reporting thresholds in local currency (USD). Multinational groups must, however, assess CbC and Master File obligations under the parent jurisdiction's laws (e.g., US, EU) and may prepare OECD-aligned TP documentation defensively for foreign tax audits. There is no RMI penalty for failing to prepare contemporaneous TP documentation.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Marshall Islands Economic Substance (Amendment) Act 2019 (as amended) and associated Economic Substance Regulations impose an economic substance test on resident entities carrying on 'relevant activities' (banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, distribution and service centre, and IP business). The subject fulfillment/kitting/assembly business (ISIC 5210) falls within 'distribution and service centre' only where the buying, selling, or provision of services is carried on with related parties. Pure third-party 3PL logistics for unrelated customers does not constitute a relevant activity. The entity must nonetheless file an annual economic substance notification through its registered agent, confirm its non-resident exempt status, and maintain documentary evidence that management, personnel, premises, and core income-generating assets are located outside the RMI.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly concealing or understating Marshall Islands-source income (e.g., warehousing fees earned from an RMI counterparty), falsely declaring NRDC exemption status, or submitting a materially false income tax return to the Revenue and Taxation Division.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Income Tax Act, criminal fines up to USD 10,000 per offense and/or imprisonment up to three years; civil penalty of 50% of the understated tax; immediate revocation of the NRDC tax-exempt status with re-taxation of all prior exempt profits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, officers, and the registered agent who knowingly participate in the false filing may be jointly and severally liable for the unpaid tax, civil penalties, and criminal fines; travel bans and asset freezes may be imposed pending prosecution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Economic Substance Non-Compliance / Shell Company Presumption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Booking substantial related-party distribution, kitting, or assembly income to an RMI entity that has no physical office, no employees, and no decision-making function in any jurisdiction (a pure paper shell), or failing to submit the annual economic substance notification.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Economic Substance (Amendment) Act, administrative fines of up to USD 10,000 for initial non-compliance and further daily penalties for continuing default; the Registrar may strike off the entity; information will be exchanged spontaneously with the parent jurisdiction's tax authority under OECD/EUR exchange-of-information mechanisms.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be disqualified from acting as directors of any RMI entity for up to five years; foreign tax authorities may disregard the RMI entity as a sham, attributing its profit to the offshore parent and imposing recharacterization penalties on the directors who signed the intercompany documents.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Conducting physical warehouse operations, employing local staff in the Marshall Islands, or furnishing logistics services entirely within RMI territory without obtaining a Business License under the RMI Business License Act or a Foreign Investment Business License (FIBL).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Daily fines for unlicensed operation, closure of the unauthorized business, forfeiture of profits derived from the unlicensed activity, and a ban on future FIBL issuance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Shareholders and directors knowingly conducting unlicensed business are personally liable for all resulting debts and statutory penalties; the corporate veil is pierced to the extent of the unlawful profit.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving large cash deposits, processing payments for sanctioned counterparties, or omitting customer due diligence (CDD/KYC) when the fulfillment entity acts as a payment intermediary for supply-chain clients.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism legislation, monetary penalties of up to USD 100,000 per violation for a body corporate, suspension or revocation of the registered agent's license, and reporting to the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Compliance officers and directors face criminal liability for wilful AML failures, including imprisonment up to five years and personal fines; directors of an intermediary payment rail may also be pursued by foreign regulators for sanctions-busting.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Director Breach of Fiduciary Duty / Fraudulent Trading
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Declaring dividends or distributions out of capital while the corporation is insolvent, executing intercompany service agreements with artificial pricing to strip value, or using the RMI entity to defraud creditors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Business Corporations Act and Marshall Islands common law, directors may be ordered to repay unlawful distributions, pay equitable compensation, and be disqualified from serving as directors of any RMI entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil may be pierced: directors face civil restitution, court-imposed travel bans, asset freezes, and criminal imprisonment for fraudulent trading; shareholders who knowingly receive tainted distributions must disgorge them with interest.
